newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kuehne sees growth in Turkish business.
newsitem.headline: Kuehne sees growth in Turkish business.

text.p: Kuehne & Nagel AG said it expects strong growth from a logistics contract with Mercedes-Benz in Turkey providing import services for the German truck manufacturer's subsidiary, Mercedes-Benz Turk .
Kuehne & Nagel is responsible for the deliveries of components for an eight-tonne truck from Indonesia, Brazil, Spain and South Africa, it added in a statement.
The components are at present imported by sea through Izmir on Turkey's western coast and amount to about 400 teu (20-foot containers) a year.
Izmir is used instead of Istanbul because of its strategic location and due to chronic overcrowding at Istanbul port, it added.
Kuehne & Nagel national manager Turkey, Werner Kleymann, said: "Production will at first be restricted to the domestic market at first and will later exported."
"Transport volumes for Mercedes-Benz Turk will thus grow strongly in the medium-term," he forecast.

Kuehne & Nagel is one of Turkey's largest air freight forwarders, with the US and the Middle East as key export markets, the statement said. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
